fields.description: Shared secret required by external voice workers when fetching this configuration.
fields.label: Voice Agent Config Secret

fields.description: Short company/site key used by the shared Render worker to identify this Frappe site. Use lowercase words with hyphens, e.g. eternity, bharat, sriaas.
fields.label: Company Key

fields.description: LiveKit project websocket URL. Example: wss://on-prem-poc-o6gqacpr.livekit.cloud. Find it in LiveKit Cloud project settings/API keys.
fields.label: LiveKit URL

fields.description: LiveKit project API key. Required so Frappe can sync SIP dispatch rules and Cloud agent secrets without `lk cloud auth`.
fields.label: LiveKit API Key

fields.description: LiveKit project API secret. Required so Frappe can sync SIP dispatch rules and Cloud agent secrets without `lk cloud auth`.
fields.label: LiveKit API Secret

fields.description: Cloud agent ID whose secrets should be updated. Find it in LiveKit Cloud -> Agents -> open agent. Example: CA_MLFjH7ffEbnd.
fields.label: LiveKit Cloud Agent ID

fields.description: Optional path to `lk` if it is not on PATH. Frappe still uses the CLI command, but with Project ID + API credentials it does not need server `lk cloud auth`.
fields.label: LiveKit CLI Path

fields.description: LiveKit Cloud project ID or slug passed as `--project`, so server `lk cloud auth` is not required. Find it in the LiveKit Cloud project URL or project switcher, e.g. p_2s1mvz37nov or gemini_live.
fields.label: LiveKit Cloud Project ID / Slug

fields.description: Server path containing gemini_live_agent.py, Dockerfile, requirements.txt, and livekit.toml.
fields.label: LiveKit Agent Source Directory

fields.description: Server path to the Google service-account JSON mounted into LiveKit Cloud agents.
fields.label: Google Credentials File

fields.description: Public URL that LiveKit Cloud uses to fetch prompt/profile config from this Frappe site. Example: http://your-domain.com, https://your-domain.com, or an ngrok URL.
fields.label: Public Frappe Base URL
